title: Certification run
description: One run of the Golden Project certification path. The deterministic suite proves the organization is coherent; this records what happened when it was run against a real project, and by what evidence. The two are never merged: `evidence` is per unit, and `verdict.real_agent` cannot be satisfied by synthetic units however many of them pass.

claude_code_version.description: The CLI actually on PATH when the run happened. Null when no CLI was present, which is itself a fact about the run.

mode.description: What was asked for. What was achieved is in `verdict`; a live run whose sessions did not start is still a live-mode run that produced no real-agent evidence.

units.description: One entry per unit of work the run drove.

model.description: The model that actually ran the work. Null for a synthetic unit: nothing ran, and naming a model there would be the exact conflation this record exists to prevent.

execution.description: The three values kept apart everywhere else in this repository: what the workflow asked for, what the resolver decided, and what the runtime reported.

isolation.description: Separate from execution mode. A subagent may run in a shared checkout or a worktree; those are different questions.

evidence.description: synthetic: the organization drove itself with no model in the loop. real-agent: a Claude Code session did the work and the result was read back from durable state, never from what the session said about itself.

probes.description: Named integration points checked against a real session. A probe passes on durable evidence -- the audit log, the work item's history, a file on disk -- never on a model's account of its own behaviour, which is the thing under test.

evidence_source.description: Where the answer was read from. `self-report` is not permitted.

real_agent.description: Never derived from synthetic units. `partial` means some probes passed and the lifecycle was not driven end to end by real agents.

certified.description: True only when real_agent is pass and every stage in `coverage.required` carries a real-agent unit. A run with a perfect synthetic result and no session is not certified, and saying so is the point of this file.
